notes:
### Added

- **Skills file browser:** every skill opens its package as a file tree — `SKILL.md` first, then `references/` and `scripts/` — with a rendered Markdown preview or source per file. Plugin skills list their real files too.
- **Manual memory and skill creation:** the New memory form (title, type, description, content) writes proper frontmatter and a `MEMORY.md` index line; deleting a memory file cleans up its index entry. New skills are created inline the same way.

### Changed

- **One layout for Memory, Skills and Subagents:** the three Agent tabs share a file-tree master-detail view with full-row selection; the Subagents side sheet is gone — detail and editor open in place.

### Fixed

- **Skill packages show all files:** plugin and imported skills list their references and scripts instead of only `SKILL.md`.
